focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业须加快碳成本核算与供应链数据准备
focus.summary: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征收阶段。涉及钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力、氢六大行业。中国出口企业需在过渡期内完成产品嵌入碳排放的核算与申报，并建立可核查的供应链碳数据体系。未及时准备的企业将面临欧盟进口商压价、订单流失及未来碳成本转嫁风险。建议企业尽快开展碳足迹盘查、完善原始数据凭证，并评估在欧盟境内设立合规实体的必要性。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会CBAM立法进程 · 2026.11.20
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Must Accelerate Carbon Cost Accounting and Supply Chain Data Readiness
focus.summary_en: The transitional period of the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) will conclude at the end of 2026, with the definitive regime applying from 2027. It covers six sectors: iron and steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity, and hydrogen. Chinese exporters are required to complete embedded emissions accounting and reporting during the transitional phase and to establish verifiable supply chain carbon data systems. Companies failing to prepare in time will face price pressure from EU importers, loss of orders, and future carbon cost pass-through risks. It is recommended that enterprises conduct carbon footprint inventories, improve primary data documentation, and assess the necessity of establishing compliance entities within the EU.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission CBAM legislative process · 2026.11.20

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决在中国法院获承认与执行：跨境仲裁保全与送达合规成关键
case.summary: 近期，某中国法院依据《纽约公约》承认并执行新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）作出的仲裁裁决。该案涉及中国企业与东南亚交易方之间的货物买卖合同纠纷。法院重点审查了仲裁协议效力、正当程序保障及公共政策抗辩。裁决执行过程中，被申请人以未收到适当通知为由提出异议，但法院认定送达符合仲裁规则。本案提示跨境交易方：仲裁条款应明确约定机构与规则，送达地址须保持有效，并注意保全申请的时限与担保要求。
case.source: 来源：中国法院涉外商事审判实践 · 2026.11
case.title_en: SIAC Award Recognised and Enforced by Chinese Court: Compliance in Cross-Border Arbitration Preservation and Service Proves Critical
case.summary_en: A Chinese court recently recognised and enforced an arbitral award rendered by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) under the New York Convention. The case involved a sales contract dispute between a Chinese enterprise and a Southeast Asian counterparty. The court focused on the validity of the arbitration agreement, due process guarantees, and public policy defences. During enforcement, the respondent challenged the award on the ground of improper notice, but the court held that service complied with the arbitration rules. This case serves as a reminder for cross-border parties: arbitration clauses should clearly specify the institution and rules, service addresses must remain valid, and attention should be paid to deadlines and security requirements for preservation applications.
case.source_en: Source: Chinese courts' foreign-related commercial adjudication practice · 2026.11

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境商事纠纷多元化解决机制再升级：前海、南沙加快构建国际仲裁与调解高地
policy.summary: 2026年11月，粤港澳大湾区在跨境争议解决领域持续推出便利化措施。深圳前海与广州南沙法院进一步优化涉外案件集中管辖与域外法查明机制，支持港澳仲裁机构在大湾区内地设立业务机构，并推动跨境调解协议司法确认。同时，广东高院发布涉港澳商事审判指引，明确港澳投资者权益保护与规则衔接。企业可善用大湾区仲裁与调解资源，在合同中约定香港或深圳作为仲裁地，并利用临时措施与保全机制提升争议解决效率。
policy.source: 来源：广东省高级人民法院、前海法院动态 · 2026.11
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Upgrades Diversified Cross-Border Commercial Dispute Resolution: Qianhai and Nansha Accelerate Development of International Arbitration and Mediation Hubs
policy.summary_en: In November 2026, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area continued to roll out facilitation measures in cross-border dispute resolution. The Qianhai and Nansha courts in Shenzhen and Guangzhou further optimised centralised jurisdiction over foreign-related cases and mechanisms for ascertaining foreign law, supported Hong Kong and Macao arbitration institutions in establishing operations in the mainland GBA, and promoted judicial confirmation of cross-border mediation agreements. Meanwhile, the Guangdong High People's Court issued guidelines on Hong Kong- and Macao-related commercial adjudication, clarifying the protection of investors' rights and rule alignment. Enterprises may leverage GBA arbitration and mediation resources, designate Hong Kong or Shenzhen as the arbitral seat in contracts, and utilise interim measures and preservation mechanisms to enhance dispute resolution efficiency.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong High People's Court, Qianhai Court updates · 2026.11

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对华出口管制穿透性规则趋严，企业须重构供应链合规与合同风险分配
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：近期美国出口管制规则呈现穿透性适用趋势，对含美国技术或软件的境外产品再出口施加更严格限制。中国出海企业面临供应链断供、次级制裁及合同违约三重风险。建议：一、对关键物项开展全链条溯源，识别美国成分占比；二、在采购与销售合同中加入出口管制合规陈述保证、不可抗力及终止条款；三、建立内部合规官与培训机制，对高风险交易进行尽职调查；四、关注中国《反外国制裁法》下的阻断与救济路径。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师团队实务观察 · 2026.11.20
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Tightening US Export Control 'Penetrating' Rules Require Companies to Restructure Supply Chain Compliance and Contractual Risk Allocation
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: Recent US export control rules show a trend of 'penetrating' application, imposing stricter restrictions on re-exports of foreign-produced items containing US technology or software. Chinese going-global enterprises face triple risks: supply chain disruption, secondary sanctions, and contractual breach. Recommendations: first, conduct full-chain tracing of critical items to identify US content thresholds; second, incorporate export control compliance representations and warranties, force majeure, and termination clauses into procurement and sales contracts; third, establish internal compliance officers and training mechanisms, and conduct due diligence on high-risk transactions; fourth, monitor blocking and redress pathways under China's Anti-Foreign Sanctions Law.
analysis.source_en: Source: Practical observations of Attorney Qin Linhao's team · 2026.11.20
